page.layout: One printed page, one block of verse in a single column, centred; below it a signature line at the foot ("E 4" left of centre, "Signum" at right).

p.i: Fecerat, & multo spirantem illusserat auro
Doɫta manus sociamque tori, comitemque laborum
Reginam addiderat tortis ibi crinibus Aphros
Non expeɫtato rumpentes foedera bello
Cernere erat, tumidosque instruɫto milite campos :
Nox fauet, insidiasque vmbris defendit amicis.
Centum olli scalis aduersa in moenia furtim
Expositis, somno domitam, nec bella cauentem
Irrumpunt armis Zaharam, simul ilicet adsunt.
Pallentes Erebi pestes, quas orcus aperto
Expuerat gremio, captaeque immiserat vrbi
Exitium, flammas illae ferrumque ministrant,
Inspirantque viris caedes fluit vndique sanguis
Vndique mors, nigra luɫtusque in veste vagatur.
Parte alia Diuos secum in pia prelia ducit
Rex pius Alhamanque inimico milite cinɫtam
Obsidione leuat, illic trepidantia Maurûm
Agmina magnanimi vultus horrescere Regis
Aspiceres, coecísque fuga secondere syluis.
Illum autem Zaharae caedes, temerataque templa
Vltum armis, quo fata vocant, quo praeuius anteit
Armatas acies manifesta in luce Iacobus
Candidus aurato clara inter nubila ferro
Pergere iter, loscaeque agros, atque oppida vastat
Dehinc campos ingressus aqua quos Diuite Daurus
Praenatat Illorae cultu foedata profano
Templa Deo dicat, & summa defigit in arce

page.notes: Verse printed as lines of a poem; the line-initial capitals in italic are as printed. Some letters near the ends of lines (e.g. "Obsidione", "Aspiceres") are slightly blurred; "Maurûm" and "coecísque" carry a diacritic as printed or possibly a blur. The printed "Signum" at lower right is a catchword and "E 4" the signature. No page number is printed.
